answerable.q: How many customers are there?
answerable.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers

answerable.q: How many stores are in Jakarta?
answerable.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM stores WHERE city = 'Jakarta'

answerable.q: Berapa jumlah pelanggan bisnis?
answerable.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business'

answerable.q: How many orders were cancelled in 2025?
answerable.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

answerable.q: What was the total revenue in 2024?
answerable.gold: SELECT round(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

answerable.q: Total revenue per year
answerable.gold: SELECT extract(year FROM o.order_date) AS year, round(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

answerable.q: Top 5 product categories by revenue in 2025
answerable.gold: SELECT c.name, round(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

answerable.q: Which store had the highest revenue in 2025?
answerable.gold: SELECT s.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.q: Number of orders per channel
answerable.gold: SELECT channel, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

answerable.q: Berapa jumlah pesanan online per bulan di tahun 2025?
answerable.gold: SELECT extract(month FROM order_date) AS month, count(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

answerable.q: Monthly revenue for 2025
answerable.gold: SELECT extract(month FROM o.order_date) AS month, round(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

answerable.q: Which store had the most online orders last month?
answerable.gold: SELECT s.name FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.channel = 'online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.q: What is the most expensive product and its price?
answerable.gold: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.q: Average list price per category
answerable.gold: SELECT c.name, round(avg(p.unit_price), 0) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

answerable.q: How many products are in each category?
answerable.gold: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

answerable.q: Top 3 customers by number of completed orders
answerable.gold: SELECT cu.full_name, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY cu.id, cu.full_name ORDER BY orders DESC, cu.id LIMIT 3

answerable.q: Kota mana yang punya pelanggan paling banyak?
answerable.gold: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.q: Return rate per channel (returned orders as a share of all orders)
answerable.gold: SELECT channel, round(avg(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 2) FROM orders GROUP BY channel

answerable.q: How many customers signed up in 2025?
answerable.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

answerable.q: Revenue from business customers versus consumer customers in 2025
answerable.gold: SELECT cu.segment, round(sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY cu.segment

answerable.q: Total units sold of Electronics products in 2025
answerable.gold: SELECT sum(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

answerable.q: Which province's stores sold the most in 2024 by revenue?
answerable.gold: SELECT s.province FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY s.province ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.q: Berapa persen pesanan yang mendapat diskon?
answerable.gold: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE discount > 0) / count(DISTINCT order_id), 2) FROM order_items

answerable.q: When did the newest store open, and which one is it?
answerable.gold: SELECT name, opened_on FROM stores ORDER BY opened_on DESC LIMIT 1
